newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit retreats on dollar/majors strength.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit retreats on dollar/majors strength.

text.p: The ringgit retreated in Asian afternoon trade on the strength of the dollar against other major currencies, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said mild commercial dollar buying from Kuala Lumpur also pressured the ringgit and pushed it beyond the intermediate support level at 2.5250.
However, volumes remained depressed for lack of much interest as the market focused on the majors.
"The big speculation now is in G-7 currencies. ASEAN has taken a back seat," a dealer with a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur said.
He said people were buying and selling in small volumes in the 2.5220/30 to 2.5250/70 range. Dollar/ringgit's next technical barrier is 2.5280.

Dealers said overnight the ringgit gained slightly on buying of ringgit/Singapore dollar cross in London. However, selling emerged in the morning and with the strong dollar/yen, the gains disappeared.
"I am still bullish on the dollar. There will be more commercial demand for it from Malaysia," a dealer with a Kuala Lumpur-based bank said.
